messages:
Ethan: Looping in infra + pricing for an enterprise POC sizing question from BetaBank. They want quick guidance for committed GPUs and autoscale rules. Traffic: avg 140 req/min (~2.33 rps), peaks to 640 req/min (~10.67 rps) for 45-90s every 8-20 minutes. Avg token load ~700 in + 200 out. Target p99 latency 250-350ms. They test with a 13B-ish model (fp16).

Sofia: Thanks 1. Convert to tokens/sec -> avg_tokens_s ~= 2.33 * 900 = 2097 toks/s, peak_tokens_s ~= 10.67 * 900 = 9603 toks/s. For 13B fp16 on H100/A100 we model ~= 2.5-4 rps per GPU for ~900 token requests with our current kernels and batching.

Sofia: Starter recommendation:
- Committed GPUs: 3 (H100) to cover sustained average and provide buffer.
- Autoscale: min_replicas=1 (infra health), reserved_replicas=3, max_replicas=9 (allows ~3x headroom).
- Warm pool: maintain 1 warm spare during business hours; prewarmed replicas scale down overnight to save cost.
- Burst handling: allow instant scale to max_replicas for 2 mins, and cap burst frequency via credits.

PerfBot: Quick calc results (conservative rps_per_gpu=3):
- reserved_gpus: 3
- reserved_gpu_hours_month: 3*24*30=2160
- estimated_burst_gpu_hours (assume 12% time in bursts at +6 GPUs): ~518 GPU-hours/month
- suggestion: run a 3-hour bench with customer's 300 prompts to refine rps_per_gpu assumption.

Ruth: Pricing for sales 1: I'll draft a provisional quote with: committed 3 GPUs 12-month term + on-demand burst rate. I'll include an option for a 4-GPU committed tier with smaller burst exposure. Include a 25% safety buffer on projected GPU-hours.

Caleb: Security ops notes: Dedicated requires VPC peering and optional private endpoints. For BetaBank we should plan for customer-managed KMS + SIEM export. Onboarding slots available next week.

Ethan: Action items: 1) Sofia/Perf team run bench tomorrow; 2) Ruth produce provisional quote; 3) Caleb send onboarding checklist; 4) I'll share sample prompts by EOD.

Sofia: I'll set up bench and post results in this thread.

Ruth: Quote draft in a couple hours.

Caleb: Checklist shared via DM to Ethan.

Ethan: Thanks team. We'll update BetaBank after results. :thumbsup:
